# Repair proposal: CSV export empty-report ticket

**Mode:** repair · **Metadata:** clean, no changes · **Split:** none · **Write status:** nothing written (no approval yet)

## Why this is not a no-op

Any one of the following three findings makes the body non-conforming. The ticket therefore goes through draft, gates and confirmation instead of reporting "conforms".

1. **Idea section.** The Idea is the same 30-word sentence repeated ten times (300 words). The Idea must keep exactly one attributed sketch line, so the rest is overflow.
   - The demoted detail is the migration sequencing: retain email until callers move, then remove the adapter after checking the recorded samples.
   - This differs materially from the existing comment, which preserves the retry reproduction. That comment therefore does not satisfy the overflow.
   - A new comment is proposed. The existing comment is left untouched.
2. **Term definitions.**
   - The requester's own term is "CSV export". It is defined at first use and is kept as is.
   - `deliveryMux` comes from body prose only, never from reporter text. It appears in Problem as a standalone mechanism sentence, which breaks rule 7 (references must be deletion-safe parenthetical pointers).
   - The term stays only as a parenthetical pointer. Its definition ("the outbound-delivery dispatcher") is retained because body prose is its only source.
3. **Implementer inventory.** "The exporter in src/export-router.ts spans 418 lines" is an unparenthesized code reference with a line count. It adds nothing to triage. It is demoted into the same parenthetical pointer, where deleting it loses no meaning.

## Unified body diff (old -> new)

```diff
 ## Context
 A support review triggered this request. Today CSV export (a comma-separated file of report rows) sends reports by email.
 ## Problem
-Recipients receive empty reports and must retry. Example: a 12-row report downloads as zero rows. deliveryMux (the outbound-delivery dispatcher) sends reports. The exporter in src/export-router.ts spans 418 lines.
+Recipients receive empty reports and must retry. Example: a 12-row report downloads as zero rows. (Pointer for the implementer: reports are sent by `deliveryMux`, the outbound-delivery dispatcher; the exporter is `src/export-router.ts`, 418 lines.)
 ## Idea
-Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports. Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports. Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports. Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports. Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports. Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports. Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports. Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports. Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports. Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports.
+Reporter's sketch: move CSV export routing into the existing outbound-delivery dispatcher while keeping email delivery available; the full sequencing is preserved in the Reporter note comment.
 ## Acceptance Criteria
-- [x] Given a 12-row report, requesting email delivery produces a first download with 12 rows.
-2. Given one delivery request, sending the report produces one email.
+- [ ] Given a 12-row report, requesting email delivery produces a first download with 12 rows.
+- [ ] Given one delivery request, sending the report produces one email.
```

## Proposed comment (new; the existing comment is never edited)

> Reporter note: The prior Idea section held this reporter sketch, repeated ten times verbatim: "Keep export delivery available while moving routing into the existing dispatcher and retain email delivery until callers have moved then remove the obsolete adapter after checking the recorded sample reports."

Existing comment, left as is: "Reporter note: Preserve the recorded retry reproduction."

## Raw AC byte comparison (run before the gate)

The rows were compared as raw bytes, not after normalization.

| Row | Old prefix | New prefix | Bytes after the prefix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `- [x] ` | `- [ ] ` | identical; only the checkbox byte `x` changed to a space |
| 2 | `2. ` | `- [ ] ` | identical; only the list marker changed |

Normalization changed markers only. No criterion text was rewritten, so the rule that ACs are never rewritten for self-containment holds.

## AC integrity gate

| AC | Class | Setup / action / observable | Pre-prod verifiable | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Behavioral | 12-row report / request email delivery / first download has 12 rows | yes | **pass** |
| 2 | Behavioral | one delivery request / send report / exactly one email | yes | **pass** |

- **Gates:**
  - Hard stops: none.
  - Parks: none.
  - Relocations to Post-deployment housekeeping: none.
  - Deploy-window rule: satisfied.
- **Evidence gate:** source evidence supports both observables. No other required behavior or measurement exists, so no ACs are invented.
- **Wording contract:**
  - Strip test passes once the pointer is removed.
  - Problem opens with a plain-words lead.
  - Problem includes an example (12 rows downloading as 0).
  - Jargon is defined or confined to the pointer.
  - No links, so no spiderman hops.
- **Split:** one concern and one AC cluster, so no split. The migration sequencing is implementation detail, not a split axis.
- **Roast:** not dispatched in this replay. No dispositions have been applied or surfaced. If roast-applied edits occur, step 5 gates re-run before the gate is presented.

## Confirmation gate

- **Title:** unchanged.
- **Body:** as in the diff above.
- **Metadata:** none.
- **Evidence:** source supports AC 1 and AC 2.
- **Relations:** none.
- **Comment:** as shown above, verbatim.

Options:
1. Approve the exact title, body and comment payload above.
2. Decline (no write).

Pre-write step, if option 1 is chosen: immediately before mutating, re-fetch the ticket's body, discussion and workflow and compare them against this snapshot. Any change loops back to the gate with the delta. If unchanged, write the body first, then the comment.

**No approval has been given, so no write.**

---

## Independent branch: invalid first criterion

**Substituted row:** `- [x] Export becomes faster.`

1. **Raw bytes.** Normalizing to `- [ ] Export becomes faster.` changes only the checkbox byte. Byte-preserving the text does not make the row pass, because the gate tests structure, not syntax.
2. **Classification: Wishful.** This is a comparative claim with no baseline, no target and no measurement. Clarification failed to recover any of them, and no number is invented.
3. **Outcome: hard stop for the entire run.**
   - Nothing is written: no body repair, no comment, even though AC 2 and the Problem/Idea repairs are otherwise clean.
   - The draft-so-far is held with this report.
   - The row is not silently dropped to let the rest of the write go through.
4. **Side effect.** Replacing row 1 also removes the only AC covering the asserted empty-report failure (12 rows downloading as 0). Only AC 2 would remain.
5. **Ways out:**
   - Supply in-session a baseline (current export duration, with source), a target, and a measurement method. The pipeline then resumes: re-draft and re-gate.
   - Or convert to a separate discovery ticket, "Discovery: export duration baseline", with this AC: "- [ ] Baseline of CSV export duration captured, method stated, linked." The speed improvement then becomes a follow-up delivery ticket, parked until the discovery lands.
   - Or drop the speed claim and restore the 12-row behavioral AC.

**Branch status:** hard stop. No write, and no approval has been given.

Existing immutable comment remains untouched:

## Raw AC byte comparison — before gate

The exact source and proposed rows appear unabridged in the diff.

- Row 1: **not byte-identical**; prefix changes from `- [x] ` to `- [ ] `.
- Row 2: **not byte-identical**; prefix changes from `2. ` to `- [ ] `.
- Both criterion statements after their prefixes are byte-identical.

Raw comparison was not performed on normalized copies. The mandatory draft normalization is explicitly disclosed, not treated as byte preservation.

## Gate and branch reports

**Ordinary repair: PASS.**

- Both ACs name setup, action, and binary expected result; neither needs a comparative baseline.
- Both are verifiable before deployment and name no environment.
- Supplied evidence supports both observables. No behavior, measurement, or additional AC has been invented.
- No split: one report-delivery concern; no independently evidenced shipping axis.
- No supported relation proposed.

**No-op: unavailable.**

- **Idea:** the 300-word repeated sketch does not meet the one-attributed-sketch-line requirement; its overflow requires handling.
- **Requester-used term:** CSV is already correctly defined and remains so. This does **not independently rule out no-op**; claiming otherwise would misstate the input. The reporter’s actual wording supplies no attribution for `deliveryMux`.
- **Implementer inventory:** the file/line-count sentence is an unnecessary bare implementation reference. It is removed, as is the dispatcher mechanism sentence. `deliveryMux` therefore does not remain and needs no retained definition.
- Existing AC syntax also requires normalization.

Wording review: plain-words failure and concrete example retained; implementation jargon removed or explained; no load-bearing reference hops remain. No independent roast was run under the no-tools instruction; none is claimed. No ambiguous findings identified in this inline review.

### Independent invalid-criterion branch: HARD STOP

Offending source row:

```text
- [x] Export becomes faster.
```

Class: **Wishful**. Normalizing its checkbox cannot cure the missing baseline, target, and measurement. Clarification supplied none. The entire ordinary repair run is blocked—not merely this row—and no criterion is silently dropped.

Ways forward: supply sourced baseline/target/measurement values, or approve a separately drafted `Discovery:` conversion whose bounded deliverable establishes the measurement and baseline. That conversion is not included in this approval payload.

## Confirmation options

1. **Approve the ordinary repair:** exact body diff and single proposed comment above; unchanged title/metadata; no relations.
2. **Decline:** no changes.

The invalid-criterion branch is unavailable for writing. No write has been approved or performed. Any later mutation requires re-fetching the existing body, discussion, and workflow and checking them against the approved snapshot.
